title: GS Guneku ex-pupils open a free-will donation drive for the school
excerpt: Former pupils of Government School Guneku opened a free-will donation drive for their old school in August 2026, collected by mobile money.
sourceNote: From the announcement circulated in the community, August 2026.
body:
In August 2026, former pupils of Government School Guneku opened a free-will donation drive in support of their old school, with contributions collected by mobile money.

The school also held its Form 1 interviews on 11 June 2026.

Anyone wishing to contribute should confirm the current collection arrangement with the school or through the Palace before sending money. This site does not publish personal collection numbers.
